Lessons are grouped by topic and numbered in the order they build on each
other: the LTEE project you create in lesson 02 grows with every lesson after
it, and each tutorial lists what it needs at the top. When each lesson is
taught is in the schedules: [7-week course](schedule-course.qmd) and
[workshop](schedule-workshop.qmd).

| Lesson | Topic | Slides | Tutorial | In short |
|--------|-------|:------:|:--------:|----------|
| 00 Setup | Getting started | | [tutorial](pages/00-setup.qmd) | Pixi, Git, GitHub, WSL2 or Codespaces |
| 01 Reproducibility and open science | Introduction | [slides](lectures/01-introduction/01-introduction.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/01-introduction.qmd) | definitions, evidence, five pillars, open science; audit a paper |
| 02 Project organization | Project organization and data management | [slides](lectures/02-project-organization/02-project-organization.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/02-project-organization.qmd) | sketch a layout, generate the project from the template |
| 03 Data management and FAIR | Project organization and data management | [slides](lectures/03-data-management/03-data-management.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/03-data-management.qmd) | FAIR and CARE, data availability; download, checksums, metadata |
| 04 Git and GitHub | Version control | [slides](lectures/04-git/04-git.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/04-git.qmd) | history, branches, pull requests, a check on every push |
| 05 Pixi | Software environments | [slides](lectures/05-pixi/05-pixi.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/05-pixi.qmd) | manifest and lock file, tasks, features, the pipeline; GitHub reruns it |
| 05b Pixi and Conda compared | Software environments | | [tutorial](pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd) | command table, import and export |
| 06 Jupyter | Notebooks and reports | [slides](lectures/06-jupyter/06-jupyter.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/06-jupyter.qmd) | notebooks that run top to bottom |
| 07 Quarto | Notebooks and reports | [slides](lectures/07-quarto/07-quarto.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/07-quarto.qmd) | a report computed from the data |
| 08 Containers | Containers | [slides](lectures/08-containers/08-containers.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/08-containers.qmd) | Docker image from the lock file; Apptainer |
| 09 Snakemake | Workflows | [slides](lectures/09-snakemake/09-snakemake.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/09-snakemake.qmd) | the pipeline as rules; the analysis question |
| 10 Nextflow | Workflows | [slides](lectures/10-nextflow/10-nextflow.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/10-nextflow.qmd) | the same pipeline, the same answer |
| 11 Documentation | Documentation and sharing | [slides](lectures/11-documentation/11-documentation.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/11-documentation.qmd) | README, licenses, citation |
| 12 Putting it all together | Documentation and sharing | [slides](lectures/12-putting-it-together/12-putting-it-together.qmd) | [tutorial](pages/12-putting-it-together.qmd) | swap and reproduce, release with a DOI |
| A Markdown | Extras | | [reference](pages/A-markdown.qmd) | the text format of everything |
| B Take-down | Extras | | [tutorial](pages/B-take-down.qmd) | free disk space, remove tools |
| C Bash 101 | Extras | | [tutorial](pages/C-bash.qmd) | practice for the command line: files, pipes, loops, a first script |
| S1 Package and share your tool | Extras (optional) | | [tutorial](pages/S1-packaging.qmd) | pyproject, conda recipe, local channel |
